question: Let $n$ be a positive integer. Now consider all numbers of the form $2^{3n+1}+2^{2n+1}$. Only one of the following statements is true regarding the last digit of these numbers. Which one is it?

options.A: It is 5 for some of these numbers but not for all.
options.B: It is 5 for all these numbers.
options.C: It is always 5 for $n\le10$ and it is 5 for some $n>10$.
options.D: It is odd for all $n$ but it is not necessarily 5.

source.title: Test of Mathematics at the 10+2 Level — Sixteenth Edition
